_comment: Era scoping (operator, 2026-11-23: Reality's eras work "like the 40k lines"): a setting's canon record tagged with eras (taxa of kind era) reaches a campaign only when the campaign shares one of them; a record with no era reaches every campaign; a campaign with no era sees all its setting's canon. Names match trimmed and without regard to case. wiki_shared/Eras.py and lib/eras.ts compute the same.

cases.name: era-less canon reaches an era campaign
a campaign with no era sees all
